topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I remember when we built that fort in the woods, how the leaves cradled our secrets like a blanket. It’s strange, isn’t it, how time can carry away the pieces of our past, leaving us to wonder if it was all just a dream. I wish I could gather those moments and weave them back into the fabric of your memories. But even if the words and faces have faded, I know the warmth and the trust we shared haven’t disappeared. They’re just waiting, like a hidden treasure, for the right moment to shine again.
